description: This file implements string mapping data structures and associated functions, including initialization, insertion, retrieval, deletion, and utility functions for string-based hashmaps and sets.

methods.name: int cmp_strmap_entry(const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * entry1,const struct hashmap_entry * entry2,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparison function for strmap entries used in hashing.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * find_strmap_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Locates a string map entry by key string.

methods.name: void strmap_init_with_options(struct strmap * map,struct mem_pool * pool,int strdup_strings)
methods.description: Initializes a string map with specified memory pool and string duplication option.

methods.name: void strmap_free_entries_(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Internal function to free entries in the map, optionally freeing their associated values.

methods.name: void strmap_clear(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Clears all entries from the map, freeing values if specified.

methods.name: void strmap_partial_clear(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Partially clears entries from the map without freeing the map itself.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * create_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str,void * data)
methods.description: Creates a new string map entry, duplicating string if needed, and allocating memory appropriately.

methods.name: void * strmap_put(struct strmap * map,const char * str,void * data)
methods.description: Inserts or updates an entry in the string map.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * strmap_get_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieves the internal representation of an entry by key string.

methods.name: void * strmap_get(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key string.

methods.name: int strmap_contains(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Checks if a key string is present in the map.

methods.name: void strmap_remove(struct strmap * map,const char * str,int free_value)
methods.description: Removes an entry from the map, freeing value if specified.

methods.name: void strintmap_incr(struct strintmap * map,const char * str,intptr_t amt)
methods.description: Increments the integer value associated with a string key.

methods.name: int strset_add(struct strset * set,const char * str)
methods.description: Adds a string to a set; returns 1 if added, 0 if already present.

ctags.name: cmp_strmap_entry
ctags.signature: (const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * entry1,const struct hashmap_entry * entry2,const void * keydata UNUSED)

ctags.pattern: /^void strintmap_incr(struct strintmap *map, const char *str, intptr_t amt)$/

ctags.pattern: /^void strmap_remove(struct strmap *map, const char *str, int free_value)$/
